# EmulatorContentClient

Unmodified Swift package snapshot from Provenance-Emu/emulator-content-server, `clients/swift`, commit `0c536ed4d46380e7f872556d1b53940378165217`. Models are generated from the OpenAPI contract. This package is vendored because SwiftPM cannot depend on a subdirectory of a Git repository.

Refresh with `python3 Scripts/update_content_client.py /path/to/emulator-content-server` after running `pnpm generate` there. Never edit GeneratedModels.swift here. MIT license is included.
